title: The Efficient stove in the corner
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：efficient　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 efficient 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the porter wrote of ① an efficient stove in the corner in the journal, and everybody in the coast said at once that it was ② more efficient than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the porter, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the efficient ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most efficient stove in the corner anybody in the coast had ever seen, or so the journal for August 1957 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too efficient to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the efficient ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an efficient system for the files, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as efficient as the system for the files they had once had in the old coast. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was efficient or not, and he said so.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something efficient, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next coast called the whole plan ⑧ quite efficient; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the efficient ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973, in silence, she wrote of another efficient stove in the corner in the same journal, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more efficient than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most efficient system for the files in the whole coast, she said in 1975, was the one she could never quite name; the efficient ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 高效（前置定语 an efficient stove in the corner：1963 年挑夫在行记里记下的那件高效的炉子）
B. adj. 高效／有效率（比较级 more efficient than：文中两处，一处比屋角的炉子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 高效／有效率（最高级 the most efficient：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 高效（表语 too efficient to do：母亲觉得它太高效，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 有效率（前置定语 an efficient system for the files：叔叔把整件事称作一桩有效率的管理办法）
F. adj. 有效率（同级比较 as efficient as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩档案的管理办法相比）
G. adj. 有效率（后置定语 something efficient：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 有效率（受程度副词修饰 quite efficient：那位游客的评价）

items.q: an efficient stove in the corner
the most efficient stove in the corner anybody
an efficient system for the files
The most efficient system for the files in

answers.why: efficient 意为“高效”，1963 年挑夫在行记里记下的是“一件高效的炉子”，此处作前置定语 an efficient stove in the corner。
efficient 意为“高效”，此处用比较级 more efficient than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
efficient 意为“高效”，行记上 八月 那行字说它是海岸里最高效的一件，故用最高级 the most efficient stove in the corner。
efficient 意为“高效”，母亲认为这件东西“太高效了，谁也用不上”，too efficient to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
efficient 意为“有效率”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩有效率的管理办法”，此处作前置定语 an efficient system for the files。
efficient 意为“有效率”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩档案的管理办法一样有效率”，同级比较用 as efficient as。
efficient 意为“有效率”，行记上那半行字要的是“有效率的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something efficient。
efficient 意为“有效率”，邻海岸来的那位游客认为这套计划“相当有效率”，quite 修饰原级 efficient。
efficient 意为“有效率”，1973 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要有效率”，故用比较级 more efficient than。
efficient 意为“有效率”，母亲 1975 年说的是“整个海岸里最有效率的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most efficient system for the files。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，挑夫在行记里记下了一件高效的炉子。（an efficient stove in the corner）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更高效。（more efficient than …）
母亲觉得它太高效，谁也用不上。（too efficient to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩有效率的管理办法。（an efficient system for the files）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩档案的管理办法一样有效率。（as efficient as …）
到了 1970 年，行记上只剩半行字：要的是一件有效率的东西。（something efficient）
answers: In 1963 the porter wrote of an efficient stove in the corner in the journal.
Everybody said it was more efficient than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too efficient to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an efficient system for the files.
He said nobody would call it as efficient as the system for the files they had once had.
By 1970 the journal asked for nothing but something efficient.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 efficient 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the porter wrote of an efficient stove in the corner in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most efficient stove in the corner in the coast, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too efficient to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an efficient system for the files, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next coast called the plan quite efficient, and everybody laughed.
The efficient ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
